candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All numbers and base text are correct, but it invents furigana for nearly every kanji in the title, the 調査時期/回答数 labels, 世論調査 and 朝日新聞; the image has furigana only on 内閣府 and 旧総理府. It also adds a '区分' header cell that is not in the image and leaves 調査時期/回答数 outside the table. Dashed underline on べきである not marked.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text, numbers and the two furigana readings are correct. It omits the (→ p. 86) reference under the title. The title is turned into a # heading, and the header cell is restructured as 調査時期（回答数（人））. Dashed underline not marked.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes:
All text and numbers are correct and (→ p. 86) is included. Furigana appears only on 内閣府 and 旧総理府, matching the image. Two-line row labels are preserved with
. Only the dashed underline on べきである is missing.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: All text and numbers are correct and (→p. 86) is included. The furigana is given as a separate line below the source note rather than attached to its kanji, which mirrors the layout but is less clearly associated. Dashed underline not marked.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: All text and numbers are correct, (→ p. 86) is included, and furigana is correctly attached inline to 内閣府 and 旧総理府. Row labels are flattened onto one line with no break, and half-width parentheses are used. Dashed underline not marked.

rationale: All five candidates get the chart data right, so the ranking turns on fidelity elsewhere. C is the most faithful: complete, furigana only where the image has it, and two-line labels preserved. E matches C but flattens the line breaks. D is equally accurate but detaches the furigana onto its own line. B drops the (→ p. 86) reference and adds a heading. A is last because it invents furigana throughout and adds a '区分' header that is not in the image. No candidate marks the dashed underline on べきである.
